title: Stanford violated its AI policy by turning a Hispanic student into a fake Black woman in ad

reports.title: Stanford Used A.I. to Swap Black Student for Hispanic Student in a Photo
Stanford R&DE Uses AI to Race Swap Students for Advertising
University confirms use of AI-edited photo amid controversy
Stanford violated its AI policy by turning a Hispanic student into a fake Black woman in ad

summary:
Stanford Residential & Dining Enterprises altered promotional photos with AI, changing students' races, genders, and body shapes. Billy Ramirez, a Stanford student, noticed he had been removed from a campus photo and replaced by an AI generated Black woman. Two other students next to him were made visibly thinner and their faces changed. Ramirez said he first found it funny, then upset, feeling silenced and erased because Stanford made choices about how he was represented.

The altered images drew thousands of reactions on the student platform Fizz. The Stanford Review says it will keep watching future advertising from Stanford R&DE as the department learns to use generative AI. No statement from R&DE is mentioned in the article.
